# Forhemit

> Forhemit is a 100% employee-ownership succession firm. Founder-led businesses sell 100% of the company to their employees through an ESOP, at a full price set by an independent appraiser, in 120 days from Documents-Ready. Based in San Francisco, working nationwide.

## Who it serves
Founder-led, profitable businesses with $3M+ revenue and 20+ verifiable U.S. employees, where the owner holds 51%+ and can be available on call for 4–12 months after close.

## Facts
- Fees: Forhemit's Custom Services fee is 3–5% of the independent valuation, set in a written fee document after that valuation. The professionals a transition needs — attorney, valuation firm, trustee, lender, administrator — are engaged by the client directly and paid by the client directly, each after a written estimate the client approves. The typical all-in cost, with market ranges for those professionals, is published on the Pricing page. No referral fees in either direction.
- Tax: §1042 tax-deferred treatment may be available to qualifying sellers. Deferral, never "tax-free".
- Personal guarantees: our standard is no personal guarantees — a term sheet demanding one is flagged as off-standard. Financing rests on the business and its future earnings.
